processNotes: Historical routing records final assembly at work center 60 for product 953; subassembly at work center 50 and the operation sequence are inferred.
The frame and other manufactured subassemblies are available for fitting; only the seat assembly is shown being assembled from its supplied nested BOM.
variantNotes: The representative product is blue, size 60, and uses frame 893, FR-T98U-60.
Blue size 46 product 970 uses frame 890, FR-T98U-46; blue size 50 product 971 uses frame 891, FR-T98U-50; blue size 54 product 972 uses frame 892, FR-T98U-54. Do not substitute the size 60 frame.

The supplied direct BOMs list the same remaining components and quantities for all four variants, including front wheel 821 and rear wheel 829. No other color or variant-specific paint substitution is supplied.

100351.title: Touring-2000 assembly overview
guidance: Support 1 EA HL Touring Frame - Blue, 60 (Product Number FR-T98U-60) in an assumed assembly stand. Fit 1 EA ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451) at the steering interface and 1 EA HL Touring Handlebars (Product Number HB-T928) at the front.
Fit 1 EA ML Touring Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-T612) to the frame and check its alignment.

Fit 1 EA ML Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-8107) and 1 EA ML Crankset (Product Number CS-6583) at the frame's crank area. Fit 1 EA Touring Pedal (Product Number PD-T852) to the crankset; the source specifies 1 EA.
Fit 1 EA Touring Front Wheel (Product Number FW-T905) at the front and 1 EA Touring Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-T905) at the rear. Check that both wheels rotate without obvious rubbing.
